name: Perplexity
description: Perplexity's Sonar search-augmented chat: grounded, cited answers rather than a raw model completion. Perplexity publishes no models-list or account endpoint, so there is no cheap authed read; every call is a billable chat completion, modelled as write:true and HITL-gated. The auth-proving call is the same /chat/completions endpoint with a dummy key, which the API rejects with a structured 401 before any completion is generated, so no spend occurs during shape-proof.

tools.name: chat_completion
tools.description: Send a grounded, cited chat completion to a Perplexity Sonar model. This spends the account's usage, so it is HITL-gated and never fired by the shape-proof harness (write:true means blind proof always SKIPs it; a real credential would also need --include-writes)

model.description: Perplexity Sonar model id (e.g. sonar, sonar-pro, sonar-reasoning)

needs_review: NO LIVE CREDENTIAL AT AUTHORING TIME: this spec is shape-proved blind only. LIVE_PROVEN needs one real pplx- key against a real (tiny max_tokens) chat completion — Perplexity has no zero-spend authed read to fall back on.

NO MODELS-LIST ENDPOINT, CONFIRMED LIVE DURING AUTHORING: a bare GET /models against Perplexity returned a plain 404, not a structured error, so it is not offered as a read tool here. chat_completion (write:true) is the ONLY tool this connector has; the test block probes the same POST /chat/completions endpoint directly with a dummy key so auth can still be proven without a separate read.

the test block is a POST with a real (tiny, max_tokens:1) request body, but the dummy API key is rejected with a structured 401 before Perplexity ever generates a completion, so the shape-proof run itself never spends against a real account; this only becomes a real completion if --live is run with a genuine credential.

NOT A TEMPLATE CHILD: unlike openai/groq/mistral/deepseek, Perplexity's distinct product (grounded, cited search-augmented answers) and lack of a models-list endpoint means this spec diverges from the openrouter template shape by necessity, per the coverage-gap plan's own note.
